title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-24 23:03:57 最新章节：第三千九百零章恐怖的光球能量
content_zh:
东玄大陆。
叶北城内！
王府密室，一名女子正在打开一道石门，石门咔嚓一声响，被缓缓推开。
映入眼帘的画面，是一位瘦骨嶙峋的少年，正被几根黑色铁锁，牢牢锁死在石门后面。
少年脸色苍白，看起来半点血色都没有，只有微弱的呼吸声，证明他还活着的事实。
女子缓缓朝少年走去，步伐轻盈，身姿俏丽。
“苏阳，今日是我最后一次取你体内之血了，想不到你倒是挺能熬，足足用了三年时间，才将你体内的至尊之血彻底抽光。还真是辛苦你了。”女子看着眼前虚弱的少年，语气冰冷无比道。
“呵呵~呵呵！”
“王....依依，就算你抽光我体内的至尊之血....又能如何？那始终不是你的血脉，我苏阳，就算死，也不会放过你的！！”少年名叫苏阳，本是叶北城苏家的少主，曾经苏家的天之骄子，叶北城最有知名度的天才少年。身怀至尊血脉，三岁踏入化灵境，五岁达到真武境，更是在十岁的时候，踏入了三玄境。
本以为带着这样的光环，苏阳有望成为叶北城有史以来第一位在十五岁之前突破到神武境的强者时。
然而一场婚姻，却让苏阳从此消失在众人眼帘。
叶北城本有三大势力，一是城主府，二是苏家，三是王家。三方势力一直和平相处，直到苏阳的出世后，至尊血脉的出现使得城主府和王家都想与苏家联姻。
就在苏阳十二岁的时候，三家便约坐在一起，让苏阳自己挑选未来老婆，先行订婚，等到十五岁之后，再举办婚礼。
也不知道苏阳当初是瞎了哪只眼睛，选择了王家千金，也就是此刻密室里的女子，王依依。
直到苏阳被王家密谋陷害，将其用八根镇魂铁锁，锁在密室后，苏阳才彻底明白了，所为的联姻，原来只是一个巨大的阴谋。
至尊血脉，本就难得。加上王依依也身怀火凤血脉，若是能够与至尊血脉相辅相成融为一体，那么王家必然会诞生出一位超级高手，什么城主府，什么苏家，也就不足为惧了。
于是，在这三年的时间里，王依依每隔三天都会来一次密室，取上一瓶苏阳身上的至尊之血。
三年时间，苏阳都已记不起自己是怎么过来的。
而整个苏家，也因为苏阳的失踪后，发生了内杠，苏阳的父母被早已想争夺家主之位的大长老所陷害，流放外地。其余与之相关的人，也都被尽数调离，实在是不听话的，也都被大长老当众击杀，以儆效尤。
从此苏家也彻底没落，被大长老所掌控，也成为了王家的傀儡家族。

“苏阳，你放心。我王依依不是什么忘恩负义之人，这么多年，也多亏了你，多亏了你体内的血脉。让我一举踏入了三玄境圆满，今日只要再取你一次血，我便可冲击神武境。”
“到时候，我一定会好好感谢你的。”
“哼！”
女子一边说，一边掏出亮闪闪的小刀，朝着苏阳已经看不见血肉的皮肤，狠狠的刺了进去。
金黄色的鲜血，一滴滴的开始往外流出，速度极其缓慢.....
女子掏出一个玉瓶，急忙朝着苏阳伤口之处接了过去。金黄色的鲜血开始滴入玉瓶之中，女子脸上的神情也不由开始兴奋起来。
就差这一步，就差这一小瓶。只要再吸收一次至尊之血，自己就会成为叶北城有史以来最耀眼的天才少女！！！
苏阳已经感受不到痛苦了，这种感觉似乎早已习惯，全身上下更是没有半点力气。
他的丹田之中，也早已枯竭。没有半点灵气....奇经八脉里面，仅有一点点血液还在流动.....
很难想象，在这样一副身躯之下，苏阳还能有力气说话。
看着王依依那贪婪的神情，苏阳忍不住发出笑声：“呵...呵呵，哈哈哈！！！”笑声虽不大，但却能够清晰的传入王依依耳中。
王依依闻言，不由皱眉，不知道苏阳死到临头了，为何还要如此大笑。
难道他已经神志不清了？
content_en:
Dongxuan Continent.
In Yebei City!
In the secret room of the palace, a woman was opening a stone door. The stone door clicked and was slowly pushed open.
The picture that came into view was that of a skinny young man, being locked tightly behind the stone door by several black iron locks.
The young man's face was pale and there seemed to be no blood at all. There was only a faint sound of breathing, proving the fact that he was still alive.
The woman slowly walked towards the boy, her steps were light and her figure was pretty.
"Su Yang, today is the last time I take blood from your body. I didn't expect you to be able to endure it quite well. It took three years to completely drain all the Supreme blood from your body. Thank you for your hard work." The woman looked at the weak young man in front of her and said in an extremely cold tone.
"Hehe~hehe!"
"Wang...Yiyi, even if you drain all the supreme blood from my body...what will happen? It is not your bloodline. I, Su Yang, will not let you go even if I die!!" The boy's name is Su Yang. He was originally the young master of the Su family in Ye Beicheng. He was once the favored son of the Su family and the most famous genius boy in Ye Beicheng. With the bloodline of the Supreme, he entered the Spirit Transformation Realm at the age of three, the True Martial Realm at the age of five, and even entered the Three Mysteries Realm at the age of ten.
I thought that with such an aura, Su Yang was expected to become the first strong man in Ye Beicheng's history to break through to the divine martial realm before the age of fifteen.
However, a marriage made Su Yang disappear from everyone's sight.
Ye Beicheng originally had three major powers, one was the City Lord's Mansion, the second was the Su Family, and the third was the Wang Family. The three parties had been coexisting peacefully until Su Yang was born. The emergence of the Supreme Bloodline made both the City Lord's Mansion and the Wang family want to marry the Su family.
When Su Yang was twelve years old, the three families sat together and asked Su Yang to choose his future wife, get engaged first, and then hold the wedding after he turned fifteen.
I don’t know which eye Su Yang was blinded in the first place, and he chose Wang Yiyi, the daughter of the Wang family, the woman in the secret room at the moment.
It wasn't until Su Yang was framed by the Wang family and locked in a secret room with eight soul-suppressing iron locks that Su Yang fully understood that the marriage was just a huge conspiracy.
The supreme bloodline is inherently rare. In addition, Wang Yiyi also possesses the Fire Phoenix bloodline. If it can complement and integrate with the Supreme bloodline, then the Wang family will definitely give birth to a super master. The City Lord's Mansion and the Su family will not be afraid.
Therefore, in the past three years, Wang Yiyi would come to the secret room every three days and take a bottle of Su Yang's supreme blood.
In three years, Su Yang couldn't remember how he got here.
The entire Su family also had internal strife after Su Yang's disappearance. Su Yang's parents were framed by the eldest elder who had long wanted to compete for the position of the head of the family, and were exiled to other places. The rest of the people related to him were all transferred away. If they were really disobedient, they were all killed by the great elder in public as a warning to others.
From then on, the Su family also completely declined. It was controlled by the great elder and became the puppet family of the Wang family.
"Su Yang, don't worry. I, Wang Yiyi, am not an ungrateful person. All these years have been thanks to you and the blood in your body. I have reached the perfection of the Three Mysteries Realm in one fell swoop. As long as I take your blood one more time today, I can reach the Divine Martial Realm."
"When the time comes, I will definitely thank you."
"Hmph!"
As the woman spoke, she took out a shiny knife and stabbed it hard into Su Yang's skin where flesh and blood could no longer be seen.
Golden blood began to flow out drop by drop, at an extremely slow speed...
The woman took out a jade bottle and hurriedly took it towards Su Yang's wound. Golden blood began to drip into the jade bottle, and the look on the woman's face couldn't help but become excited.
All it takes is one step, one vial. As long as he absorbs the blood of the Supreme once more, he will become the most dazzling person in Ye Beicheng's history.Genius girl! ! !
Su Yang couldn't feel the pain anymore. He seemed to be used to this feeling, and there was no strength left in his whole body.
His Dantian has long been exhausted. There is no aura...in the eight extraordinary meridians, only a little bit of blood is still flowing...
It was hard to imagine that with such a body, Su Yang could still have the strength to speak.
Seeing Wang Yiyi's greedy expression, Su Yang couldn't help laughing: "Haha...haha, hahaha!!!" Although the laughter was not loud, it could clearly reach Wang Yiyi's ears.
When Wang Yiyi heard this, she couldn't help but frown. She didn't know why Su Yang was laughing so much when his death was imminent.
Could it be that he has lost his mind?
